hero.title: Air France: integrating green testing into application quality
hero.subtitle: Air France integrated Greenspector Studio into its Service Center Test to add green testing capability to the quality validation of its web and mobile applications.

intro.title: Adding digital sobriety to the Service Center Test
paragraphs: Air France's Service Center Test validates the quality of mobile and web applications for customers and business teams.
Air France IT has strong Responsible Digital objectives. It therefore wanted to add new capabilities to validate application frugality and eco-responsibility.
The challenge was to integrate this approach into existing test and software quality practices, while enabling teams to track improvements concretely.

items.title: A tool choice suited to the need
items.text: The Sogeti team in place advised Air France on choosing a green testing tool suited to its challenges and application context.

items.title: Operational deployment of Greenspector Studio
items.text: The Greenspector Studio licence was deployed by the vendor so teams could measure and track application frugality.

items.title: Team upskilling
items.text: Air France and Sogeti staff were trained to use Greenspector Studio, which they now use daily.

items.title: Concrete results to engage with business teams
items.text: Measurements show improvements achieved, identify overconsumption and guide corrections in upcoming releases.
